source: FEATURE-20261119-heavy-sentry-citadel-look-sub1 (D14363-D14366, D14369). Heavy Sentry 340522-340525 = clones of the large starbase batteries without a group change (category 23, so EveJS serves shooting, ammunition and destruction): 340522 Projectile <- Large Artillery Battery 16689 (group 426), 340523 Hybrid <- Large Railgun Battery 16692 (group 449), 340524 Laser <- Large Beam Laser Battery 16694 (group 430), 340525 Missile <- XL Torpedo Battery 17773 (group 417). SDE 3396210 typeDogma: shield 100000, armor 1500000, hull 100000 (1.7 million HP), signature 18000, XL ammunition (chargeSize 4; torpedo battery charge group 476 XL Torpedo); no dogma override (D14364). Blueprints 340526-340529 = clones of Spatial Attunement Unit Blueprint 33196 (like the mobile-sentries pack) with the battery blueprint group 854/855/853/871 (category 9). Copying 9600 s, ME/TE 4200 s and max 10 runs = vanilla Large Artillery/Large Railgun/Large Beam Laser/XL Torpedo Battery Blueprint 2805/2804/2830/2822 (SDE 3396210 blueprints.jsonl); manufacturing 24000 s, Industry V, plain minerals (D14365): about 10x the Mobile Sentry + 5000 Isogen, 1000 Nocxium, 250 Zydrine. iconID = the weapon icons of the mobile-sentries pack (389/349/352/169); blueprints keep 33196's icon 2185. Names of the sources: public ESI (the local SDE has no types.jsonl). marketGroupID null: no market on the server. Shop 750 million ISK per blueprint. Client: re-run ApplyClientData.

overrides.name: Heavy Sentry (Projectile)
overrides.description: Heavy self-contained sentry gun built from a large starbase battery (1.7 million HP). Launch it from your cargo, then Anchor it 5-30 km from a stargate, an NPC station or your corporation's Upwell structure (low/null/wormhole space only by default). No control tower and no fuel. Load ammunition into it like a starbase battery: XL projectile ammunition, as the Large Artillery Battery. Shoots NPC ships of factions hostile to you; never shoots players. Max 2 heavy sentries per system (1 per corporation) by default. Destructible.
